flows.title: Negligence Claim Flow
flows.description: Flow from identifying a potential negligence claim through duty/breach/causation/remoteness analysis to defences and quantum.

flows.title: Defamation Claim Flow
flows.description: Flow from identifying a defamatory statement through establishing elements and defences to remedies and trial.

flows.title: Vicarious Liability Assessment Flow
flows.description: Flow from identifying the tortfeasor through employment relationship and course of employment analysis to employer defences and indemnity.

flows.title: Occupiers' Liability Claim Flow
flows.description: Flow from identifying the occupier and entrant category through breach and damage analysis to defences.

flows.title: Nuisance and Rylands v Fletcher Claim Flow
flows.description: Flow from identifying the type of interference through establishing elements to defences and remedies.

flows.title: Economic Torts Claim Flow
flows.description: Flow from identifying economic harm through analysing each tort's elements to defences and available remedies.

flows.title: Limitation Period Check Flow
flows.description: Flow from identifying the applicable limitation period through accrual date and extension analysis to outcome determination.
